thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — elevated GPU prefill OOM rate in gpu-pool-prod-us-east-1. Error spikes started ~08:34 UTC. Auto-restarts observed on 3 containers. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:
alice: I'm on it. Seeing a bunch of SIGKILL + CUDA OOM in the runtime logs. Prefill sizes spike from a few requests with 200k token windows.
raj: tagging runtime team. Maya — any recent kernel or driver changes?
maya: no driver changes. We rolled a model variant last night (v2.1-quant) to that pool. Could be larger per-request context. Pulling last 500 prefill traces now.
ben: CS reports a customer (acme-analytics) experiencing 5xxs and retries — they saw 30% failed generations in the last 10m. Keeping them updated.
chris: I'm going to drain the affected nodes from LB and spin up warm nodes in another pool to reduce noisy neighbor risk. Starting node drain now (cordon + evict).
alice: mitigation checklist: 1) drain nodes (chris) 2) apply per-request prefill cap (trim long context) 3) fallback to smaller model variant (v2.0) 4) enable cold-model fallback for huge contexts. I'll try 2 and 3 now.
maya: log snippet (tail): ```2026-03-17T08:35:12Z [worker-7] prefill: requested_window=245760 requested_kv=... CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at alloc 0x7f..```
raj: thanks — suggests a long-context prefill allocation. If we can't avoid large prefill we should force stream-trim to reduce static allocation.
chris: drained 2/3 nodes. Evictions completed, new nodes added to pool-2. Traffic shifting.
alice: applied runtime flag --prefill-max-tokens=65536 and set model-fallback policy to prefer v2.0 for that pool. Watch for regressions.
ben: told acme-analytics we're mitigating and may see shorter context truncation; they acknowledged. No revenue-critical SLAs impacted yet but ongoing.
maya: runtime metrics: OOM rate dropped from 18% -> 4% in the last 3m after caps + drain. Container restarts reduced.
raj: good. Action items: - postmortem to include request-context distribution, model-variant memory profiling, and a safer rollout checklist for quantized variants. - follow up with product on per-tenant context limits.
alice: handing off to overnight oncall chris in 30m. chris — any blockers?
chris: monitoring. I'll escalate to SRE if OOM > 10% again. Leaving probes enabled and alerts set at 8% OOM rate.
incident-bot: INCIDENT update recorded. Pager cleared for alice. Next update due in 30m or on threshold breach. :white_check_mark:
__note: This document is a single Slack thread string. Messages are chronological and prefixed with sender display names as required.
